Mr. Doby attended LIU but did not graduate. He was honored by LIU in 1996 when he received an Honorary Doctor of Humane Letters. Lorna Forde-Mitchell LIU Brooklyn '79, a former two-time indoor world record holder in the 500-meter and 440-yard dashes, Lorna represented her native Barbados in the 1972 and 1976 Olympic Games and won bronze in the 400-meters and finished seventh in the 200-meter at the 1975 Pan American Games Fred Gaudelli LIU Post '82, Lead Producer of NBC’s Sunday Night Football James Jones LIU Brooklyn '09, Centerfielder, MLB Seattle Mariners George O. Kalafatis LIU Brooklyn '65, Lawyer and Sports Agent, George was also a former baseball player who played in the Detroit and Montreal farm systems Vin Lananna LIU Post '75, '91, most recently serving as Head Coach of the national champion Oregon Ducks cross country team, Vin has a long legacy of coaching extraordinary runners, including many Olympic and world champions as well as the nation’s most respected track and field program at Stanford University. Vin began his career as a team mentor for the LIU Post Pioneers. Tim McIntee LIU Post '89, a lacrosse midfielder standout, Tim went on to play with Team USA in the 1990 World Championships and as a member and captain of the New York Saints. Most recently, Tim served as Assistant Coach for the Dartmouth men’s lacrosse team.
